column1: Cook bacon until crispy, remove and set aside.
Brown chicken pieces in bacon fat.
Add pearl onions and mushrooms, cook until browned.
Add wine and stock, bring to simmer.
Add thyme and return bacon to pot.
Cover and braise for 1.5-2 hours until tender.
Serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes."
